'''Katooni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tholothian/Legends|Tholothian]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===The Gathering===
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[near-Human]] of [[Tholothian/Legends|Tholothian]] blood,<ref name="TG" /> Katooni was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. Like other Jedi of [[Tholothian/Legends|Tholothian]] decent, Katooni donned a [[Tholoth headdress/Legends|traditional headdress]] of dangling seedpods recovered from the planet [[Tholoth/Legends|Tholoth]].<ref name="EP1VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Order's members were forced to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. As the war was waged across the galaxy, Katooni was deemed to be one of the top members of her [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]]<ref name="TGGuide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep506|text="The Gathering" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> and suitable to travel to the sacred Jedi world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]<ref name="TG" /> to participate in the ancient ritual known as [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]].<ref name="TGGuide" /> Escorted to Ilum by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Katooni and other Initiates entered the hidden [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]] and met with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] inside the caves.<ref name="TG" />

[[File:KatooniSWE.png|thumb|left|160px|Jedi Initiate Katooni]]
Katooni and other Initiates entered the caves in search of their [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]]<ref name="TG" /> for use in their personal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="ATS">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref> Katooni accompanied her fellow Initiate [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]] as they searched deep in the labyrinthine caves. Coming across a massive cliff, Katooni found her crystal at the peak of the frozen wall of ice. Zatt departed from Katooni to find his crystal. Climbing up the rock face, Katooni retrieved the crystal and found a passageway at the top of the cliff. She rushed into the passageway rather than climbing back down, but fell through a weak patch of ice. Trapped in a frozen chamber near the mouth of the caves, Katooni called for help and saw [[Petro/Legends|Petro]] on the other side. Petro, however, refused to help as his time was almost up and he had yet to find his crystal. Alone and fearful of freezing to death, Katooni gave in to despair and wept. As the gates were almost frozen over, Petro realized his error and returned to Katooni and gave her the courage needed to escape the ice cave and make her way back out of the caves to the applause of her friends. Outside the caves, Master Yoda commended Katooni in having confidence and other [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] as well.<ref name="TG" />

===Attack on the ''Crucible''===
{{Quote|I think you finished your lightsaber. Doesn't mean you know how to use it.''"<br />"''Well, if you hurried with yours, we might find out.''"<br />"''I'll finish mine when I'm ready.|Katooni and Petro|<ref name="BFR">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>}}
[[File:YounglingsAfterTheGathering-ATS.jpg|thumb|320px|Katooni, Petro, Gungi and Byph after [[Gathering (20 BBY)/Legends|The Gathering]]]]
After the Gathering, Tano prepared to escort them back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="ATSGuide" /> While the ''Crucible'' was in deep space, Katooni and other younglings continued their training under the direction of [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]],<ref name="ATS" /> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] prime lightsaber designer and engineer.<ref name="ATSGuide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep507|text="A Test of Strength" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Huyang showed the younglings the countless models of lightsabers and asked them to visualize their models. While Katooni and other younglings began the construction of their lightsabers, [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his pirates [[Raid on the Crucible/Legends|attacked]] the ''Crucible'' to steal the younglings' crystals so that Ohnaka could sell them on the black market. After the pirates boarded the ''Crucible'', Huyang ordered the younglings to hand over their crystals to him for safekeeping, but Petro didn't hand his over. Katooni and the others hid<ref name="ATS" /> in the ventilation shaft,<ref name="ATSGuide" /> where Tano ordered [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]] and Zatt to make their way to the cockpit, find [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and secure the ship's bridge. Katooni, [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], Petro and [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]] would follow Huyang and seal themselves in the ship's hold and await Tano's command. Tano intended to reroute the ship's power to the engines so the ''Crucible'' could break free of the pirate ship's grip.<ref name="ATS" />

Ohnaka ordered the pirates to smoke the younglings out of the ventilation shaft and secure the crystals, and soon Katooni and her fellows started coughing as gas grenades filled the ventilation shafts with choking smoke. Huyang lifted the floor panel to emerge in a corridor, and he was immediately throttled by a pirate. The pirates demanded that the captive younglings hand over their crystals. Petro pulled out his lightsaber, opened its crystal chamber, and inserted his shard, but Katooni warned him that his lightsaber would explode. However, he ignited his blade, looking to fight, but the gleaming blue shaft faded out. The pirates chuckled and snatched the lightsaber, but Petro's lightsaber exploded in the pirate's grip. The younglings and Huyang dashed away from the stunned pirates. Huyang instructed them to continue to the hold; he had been damaged in the explosion and couldn't aid Katooni and her fellow younglings in battle.<ref name="ATS" />

[[File:YounglingsSurrounded-ATS.png|thumb|left|270px|Katooni, Petro, Byph and Gungi are surrounded by the pirates aboard the ''Crucible''.]]
In the training room, Katooni and Gungi set the training remotes to their highest power settings and programmed them for defense. Running from two pirates, Byph lured the pirates into the room. Katooni called Zatt to seal the room from the bridge. The remotes swarmed the Weequays, relentlessly zapping them. But Katooni and her fellows couldn't make it to the hold. Ohnaka and his pirates stood in the way; the younglings were surrounded by pirates. Ohnaka demanded that the young Jedi hand over the crystals. Suddenly, Tano arrived. She Force-pushed most the pirates out of the way, allowing Katooni and her fellows to get to the hold. They drove the pirates from the ship, but Ohnaka captured Tano.<ref name="ATS" /> So the younglings were alone and stranded.<ref name="BFR" />

===Rescuing Tano===
{{Quote|This is the ''Crucible'' calling the Republic fleet. Come in, please. We need help.|Katooni|<ref name="BFR" />}}
[[File:KatooniFreesAhsoka-BFR.png|thumb|280px|Katooni frees [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] from [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his pirates]].]]
After Ohnaka's raid on the ''Crucible'', the younglings called for help,<ref name="ATS" /> and Katooni contacted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kenobi hailed the younglings and promised<ref name="BFR" /> to send [[Cody/Legends|Commander Cody]]<ref name="EP08Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep508|text="Bound for Rescue" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> to pick up the stranded younglings. However, Kenobi suffered a [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|surprise attack]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]<ref name="BFR" /> and was eventually defeated.<ref name="ANB">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref> Meanwhile, Katooni and the younglings continued their guidance of building their lightsabers aboard the ship,<ref name="EP08Guide" /> but only Katooni couldn't finish her lightsaber. When Petro wanted to disobey Kenobi's advice and rescue Tano by the younglings themselves, Katooni was not in favor of the plan, but when it appeared that the ship's coolant was leaking, the younglings had to travel to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. While leaving R2-D2 to repair Huyang and [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]] to watch the ship, Katooni went with the group and were able to persuade themselves by joining [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]], a circus act led by [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo]], as acrobats. During the show, Katooni stole Tano's lightsabers from a drunk Ohnaka. While Ohnaka was still drunk, Tano and the younglings escaped aboard a [[WLO-5 speeder tank/Legends|WLO-5 speeder tank]]<ref name="BFR" /> and headed back to the ''Crucible''.<ref name="ANB" />

===Battle on Florrum===
Katooni and her fellows were eventually recaptured<ref name="ANB" /> by [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]]<ref name="EP08Guide" /> and his pirates, but when Grievous arrived on the planet, Tano persuaded the pirates to release her and the younglings so that they could rescue Ohnaka. While breaking Ohnaka out of his cell, Katooni completed her lightsaber with encouragement from Huyang and Ohnaka. When they fled to get Ohnaka's private fleet of ships, Katooni traveled with the pirates<ref name="ANB" /> aboard [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk speeder bike]].<ref name="EP09Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep509|text="A Necessary Bond" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> As Ohnaka was planning to abandon Tano and the other Jedi, Katooni pointed out that they had all trusted him, and Ohnaka agreed to help them escape from Grievous.<ref name="ANB" />

[[File:KatooniPetroMiniJedi-ANB.png|thumb|left|280px|Katooni and Petro work together to take down several battle droids]]
Taking<ref name="ANB" /> the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']],<ref name="EP09Guide" /> which Ohnaka had retrieved<ref name="ANB" /> after it had crashed,<ref name="LT">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> Ohnaka waited until the other Jedi were all on board so that they wouldn't get caught in the blasts, then fired upon General Grievous and quickly left the planet as the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] arrived. After returning the Jedi<ref name="ANB" /> to Kenobi's ship<ref name="EP09Guide" /> and reuniting with Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ohnaka pretended that the entire thing had been a rescue mission from the start. Just before he left, Katooni caught his eye. Ohnaka gave her a small smile and a nod of appreciation. After the pirates left, Kenobi formally welcomed the younglings into the Jedi Order.<ref name="ANB" /> Katooni and her fellows eventually returned to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="TWJ">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="DS1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> Katooni and her fellow younglings were training under Jedi Master [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] at the Jedi Temple. When it was revealed that [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] was the one behind<ref name="TWJ" /> the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|Bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]]<ref name="S">{{TCW|Sabotage (episode)}}</ref> and death of [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]] by blame Tano,<ref name="TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> Skywalker dueled Offee to the training ground where Katooni and her fellows were training.<ref name="EP20Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep520|text="The Wrong Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Offee was defeated.<ref name="TWJ" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:HuyangEncouragesKatooni-ANB.png|thumb|250px|Katooni encouraged to complete her lightsaber by Professor Huyang]]
A shy and timid girl,<ref name="KatooniSWE" /> Katooni's confidence increased after her success in getting her lightsaber crystal.<ref name="TG" /> However, she had difficulty putting her lightsaber together;<ref name="BFR" /> eventually Ohnaka encouraged her to complete it.<ref name="ANB" /> Although Ohnaka had captured and even threatened to kill the younglings,<ref name="ATS" /> Katooni realized that he wasn't all bad and persuaded him to repay his debt to the Jedi.<ref name="EP09Guide" /> She and Tano were the only members of the group whom the pirate seemed to respect.<ref name="ANB" /><ref name="EP09Guide" /> Although she was a Jedi,<ref name="TGGuide" /> Katooni was not always able to hide her emotions and was full of fear and despair when she was trapped in the ice cave, afraid that she would freeze to death.<ref name="TG" />

==Powers and abilities==
Katooni was a young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] and one of the top in her class. She could use [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], such as when building her lightsaber and when she was trapped in the ice cave, though she needed Petro's help to break it. She was also capable with her lightsaber, being able to destroy several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

==Behind the scenes==
Katooni first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Season Five]]''{{'s}} episode "[[The Gathering (episode)|The Gathering]],"<ref name="TG" /> the first episode in a four-part story arc,<ref name="SW Blog: Insider 137">{{SW|url=news/whats-inside-star-wars-insider-137|text=What's Inside ''Star Wars Insider'' #137|nolive=1}}</ref> which was titled "Young Jedi" and previewed as a full-length 80-minute feature at [[Celebration VI]] in [[August]] [[2012]].<ref name="TFN Young Jedi">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/latestnews/story/CVI_TCW_Young_Jedi_Arc_Previewed_147724.asp|text=CVI: ''TCW'' "Young Jedi" Arc Previewed on TheForce.net|author=Eric|archivedate=20190730010724}}</ref>
